coverage.note: 1994-01-05 to 1994-12-07. Only the 1994 meetings of the combined 1993-1994 volume (minutesofmeeting19931994s) were extracted; 1993 meetings belong to a separate task. 32 regular meetings read end to end, January 5 to December 7, 1994; no special meetings, site inspections, or executive sessions were found in the 1994 portion. Scan quirks: the May 25 meeting heading is misread by OCR as MAY 2 7 1994 (cont'd headers consistently say MAY 25, 1994); a header reading AUGUST 19, 1994 is a misread of AUGUST 10 on the final page of the August 10 meeting, so there is no August 19 meeting; September 7 was a scheduled date (94-092 was rescheduled to it on August 10) but no September 7 meeting appears in the volume and 94-092 was instead heard September 21. Conflicts recorded as printed: 94-011 (May 4) lists only four commissioners present but records the vote as 5-0; 94-088 prints 338 Brazil Street while 94-089 prints 338 Brazil Avenue; the November 16 penalty actions for 94-165 and 94-166 are interleaved in the OCR and were matched to their appeals by their speakers. Skips of note: vehicle/taxi/peddler/street-artist/mobile-caterer appeals with no building address (including the horse-drawn carriage appeal 94-125, continued October 12 to November 9 and November 9 to December 14, never recorded), appeals about permits revoked or denied for alleged criminal conduct, jurisdiction grants (procedural), findings and resolution adoptions, court outcomes, correspondence, and rules amendments. Open threads into 1995: 94-175 (5320 Geary Blvd.) continued December 7 to December 14, 1994, a meeting not in this volume; 94-125 continued to December 14, 1994 (skipped, no building address); 94-049 (Harney Way driveway, Block 4977 Lot 8) last continued July 13 to August 17 and never heard again in 1994; findings for 94-158, 94-164, and 94-169 were still to be prepared at year end. One person's name was found in a draft reader note during the independent close-out name re-scan and removed before delivery; the delivered file was re-scanned clean.
